title: The flamingo head-flag challenge (campers)
storyboard: Film: 8–10 campers in a tight flock, heads flicking left-right in sync to the beat; wide + side, 3 takes

scenes.headline: The original: greater flamingos flagging their heads in sync.
Group displays get the whole colony ready to breed
scenes.body: Syncing up helps the flock lay eggs at the same time when conditions are right.

scenes.headline: Flag. Flick. Freeze.
scenes.body: Filmed at a Muddy Lessons nature study camp.

caption:
Our campers tried the original group dance.

In large colonies, thousands of flamingos can display together, lifting and turning their heads at the same moment.

Source: Smithsonian's National Zoo.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Storyboard: human trend version — campers copy a real courtship display (real Camargue courtship footage, labelled as slowed), then the science; ties to Muddy Lessons nature camps.
